# mrtileplot

<!-- badges: start -->

<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of mrtileplot is to provide a function to create a tile plot for multiple regions and annotations.

## Installation

You can install the development version of mrtileplot from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("LASNunes/mrtileplot")
```

## Example

This is a basic example:

```{r example}
library(mrtileplot)
## example code

# Example region data
head(example_regions)

# Example annotation data
head(example_annotations)

# Set colour palette
example_pal <- c(
  "Pos" = "forestgreen", "Neg" = "darkorange", 
  "Female" = "grey20", "Male" = "white", 
  "Stage I" = "grey20", "Stage II" = "grey", "Stage III" = "white", 
  "Right colon" = "grey20", "Left colon" = "grey", "Rectum" = "white")

# Create a tile plot
p <- mr_tileplot(region_data = example_regions, 
                 annotation_data = example_annotations, 
                 palette = example_pal)

plot(p)
```
